metadata.description: Probe client plugins (experiment tracking + read-only MCP + transcript capture).

plugins.name: probe
plugins.description: Experiment-tracking skills (probe:probe, probe:track-work, probe:visualize-progress, probe:instrument-code, probe:plan-research-review) wired to a read-only Probe MCP server; writes via the `probe` CLI.

plugins.name: probe-daemon
plugins.description: The daemon profile (installed by `probe wizard` in place of probe): the Probe daemon records and reads for your coding agent. Carries instrument-code, plan-research-review, visualize-progress, the daemon's messages and questions, and the guard; no MCP.

plugins.name: probe-tap
plugins.description: Ships client-sanitized per-session Claude Code or Codex transcripts to Probe with source-bound device authentication.

plugins.name: probe-hooks
plugins.description: Probe's hook proxy, installed by `probe wizard`: hands each hook event to the Probe service on this machine. Its files never change.
